title: Doobies Vanilla+
description: Explore a world reborn with completely overhauled dimensions, deeper caves, and more rewarding structures.
body: Explore a world reborn with completely overhauled dimensions, deeper caves, and more rewarding structures. Master the expanded cooking system from Farmer's Delight, travel with Waystones, and enjoy countless quality-of-life improvements that respect the original game's feel. This pack is perfect for anyone seeking a polished and deeply immersive survival adventure.
